check_pyro_connection: run a script that checks if a PyRO4 named object is reachable via a nameserver
run_check_connected: run the check_connected script with a PyRO name and nameserver to test connectivity
test_pyro_bind: test whether a PyRO4 proxy can successfully bind to a named object on a nameserver
review_check_connected: review the check_connected script that validates PyRO4 connectivity using exit codes 0 or 1
summarize_check_connected: summarize the check_connected script that silently checks PyRO4 named object availability
